sleeves.name: trend
sleeves.desc: Dual momentum: top 3 of 8 ETFs by 12-1 month return, only if they beat T-bills (else BIL). Monthly.

sleeves.name: volcore
sleeves.desc: SPY/AGG/GLD weighted by inverse 60-day volatility, scaled to a target volatility. Weekly.

sleeves.name: quality
sleeves.desc: Quality + low-volatility + dividend ETFs (QUAL, USMV, SCHD), equal weight. Quarterly.

sleeves.name: macro
sleeves.desc: Regime switch: SPY when credit (HYG/IEF) is above its 50-day average and SPY is above its 200-day; else 50% IEF / 50% GLD. Weekly.

sleeves.name: dipbuy
sleeves.desc: Buy SPY/QQQ dips (2-day RSI under 10) only in an uptrend (above 200-day); exit when RSI > 60 or after 5 days.

sleeves.name: crypto
sleeves.desc: BTC/ETH trend: hold a coin when it is above its 100-day average, sized to a volatility target; else cash.
